lookover.note: lookover.dev, the landing page and the docs, on Astro and Starlight (ADR 0062, ADR 0064). Built by `bun run site:build` into dist; nothing else in the workspace imports it.

imports.@lookover/web: the design system's tokens, `@lookover/web/tokens.css`, imported from the site's CSS and Astro files only, so the site's colours and type are the app's (ADR 0064, 3), and `@lookover/web/github-colours.css`, GitHub's colours for the landing page's demo card, as the app's mock GitHub view draws it
imports.@lookover/agent-cli: in tests only: the coding agent's page lists every exit code `lookover wait` and `feedback` have and `wait`'s defaults (`USAGE`), and `reply`'s claims (`CLAIMS`), so the page and the command can't drift apart; the landing page's story types only commands `USAGE` takes
